body.text: _(sda)_ Masai Russell ran a world record in the 100m hurdles in Zurich. The American lowered her personal best by five hundredths of a second to 12.09 seconds.

Russell, who had already broken the North American record the previous year, clearly dominated the competition. Second-placed Nigerian Tobi Amusan crossed the finish line in 12.23 seconds, recording a season best. Dutchwoman Nadine Visser completed the podium, also running a season best in 12.34 seconds.
